name: noootwo-vibe
description: A Noootwo multi-skill workspace for controlled AI software development, user-centered product decisions, design, code review, and documentation.

interface.longDescription: Noootwo Vibe bundles focused skills for lightweight AI workflow control, user-centered product scope and flow decisions, research-backed design work, lens-based code-health review, and documentation hygiene.
defaultPrompt: Use Noootwo Workflow for non-trivial development tasks, lifecycle guardrails, correction-loop routing, and specialist handoff.
Use Noootwo Product before design or implementation when real user, first loop, scope, main path, states, acceptance, or product choice is unclear.
Use Noootwo Design for UI, visual, artifact, or frontend design work after product path is clear; use Style Evidence Check only for high-risk style work.
Use Noootwo Review for focused code/project-health review before submit, release, or risky implementation.
Use Noootwo Docs to place verified workflow, product, design, review, release, or repository facts in the right documentation layer.
